name: JSON 유효성 검사
command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, glob
paths = [
    "plugins/harness-guard/.claude-plugin/plugin.json",
    "plugins/harness-guard/.codex-plugin/plugin.json",
    "plugins/harness-guard/hooks/hooks.json",
    "plugins/harness-guard/codex/hooks/hooks.json",
    ".claude-plugin/marketplace.json",
    "templates/settings.json",
    "packaging/packages.json",
    "docs/pilots/external-pilot-provenance.json",
    "docs/pilots/codex-split-loader-v0.61.0.json",
    "docs/pilots/codex-split-runtime-v0.61.0.json",
] + sorted(glob.glob("templates/permissions/*.json"))
for p in paths:
    json.load(open(p))
    print("OK", p)
EOF
